notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Custer County Fair (Westcliffe), 719-480-7230, Wendy Rusk. Kristy left a message May 11, 2026. Adventure Zone has older Gmail outreach to Wendy for the Custer County Fair/Westcliffe Stampede. Source: handwritten call notes page 81; Adventure Zone Gmail.
